Renders markdown with Streamdown, which is purpose-built for streaming LLM output (it gracefully handles incomplete markdown mid-stream). Fenced code blocks render via the library CodeBlock. Falls back to preformatted text until Streamdown loads or when it is not installed.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/Markdown.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { Markdown } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
